dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature with a smooth spline transition from a broad base to a tapered apex, exhibiting moderate falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded to obtuse apex morphology with a distinct white pixel-cluster marking on the posterior-superior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear to slightly convex anterior margin with a steep inclination of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1.2 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: White depigmented notch located on the upper trailing edge near the apex and extensive white punctate stippling across the lower anterior and basal regions.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density white stippling pattern concentrated along the lower leading edge and basal pixels.
